property_summary: After a first successful fallback call at block number N with timestamp t1<N, any second fallback call at a strictly later timestamp t2 with t2<=N must still succeed under the reference (which stored timestamp t1, so t2>t1), but the mutant stored the block number N so the require(block.timestamp>pastBlockTime) fails for t2<=N.
change_summary: Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value is the block number instead of the timestamp.
